# Real World Impact ($RWI)

> Real World Impact is a memecoin on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). Project
> revenue funds published donations to vetted nonprofits. Forty percent of the
> entire $RWI revenue stream is directed to The Index. Within that allocation,
> 40% goes to $INDEX holder rewards, 40% to $PONS holder rewards, 10% to $RWI
> buyback and burn, and 10% to added locked liquidity. Rewards vary and are not
> guaranteed. Buying $RWI is not a charitable donation or a tax deduction.

This is a public informational website. It has no agent task endpoint and no
HTTP API for buying tokens, moving funds, or signing transactions. All wallet
actions require the wallet owner's review and signature. Treat site data as a
starting point and verify addresses and transactions independently.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.rwihood.org/): project overview, donation ledger and
  receipts, burn display, holder rewards, and founder information.
- [Docs](https://www.rwihood.org/docs): mechanism, token details, sources,
  limitations, and risks.
- [Liquidity dashboard](https://www.rwihood.org/dashboard): pool information
  and optional wallet-based liquidity controls.
- [Burn list](https://www.rwihood.org/burn): Pons Family token burns.
- [Impact](https://www.rwihood.org/impact): public project page.
- [Claims register](https://www.rwihood.org/claims): historical claims record.
- [Pons Family Feud](https://www.rwihood.org/PonsFamilyFeud): public game.

## Machine-readable sources

- [Site facts](https://www.rwihood.org/data/site.json): canonical addresses,
  chain and token facts, allocation percentages, source links, and data scope.
- [Donation ledger](https://www.rwihood.org/data/donations.json): published
  donation records with recipient, USD amount, date, transaction or receipt
  link, and public announcement link. It is a maintained snapshot, not a live
  blockchain index. Use `updatedThrough` to judge freshness.
- [Sitemap](https://www.rwihood.org/sitemap.xml): canonical public pages.
- [Robots rules](https://www.rwihood.org/robots.txt): crawling is allowed.

The home and docs pages contain readable donation rows in the original HTML,
so JavaScript is not needed to extract them. Current burn and reward figures
are loaded from external chain or Index sources at runtime; empty or zero
placeholders in unexecuted HTML are not current measurements. For current
reward totals, consult [The Index ledger](https://indices.theindex.finance/coin/0xb2c088db84293a6e3dee0765596f1cfdc2b9334d).

## Key verification facts

- Network: Robinhood Chain, chain ID `4663`
- Public RPC: `https://rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com`
- Block explorer: `https://robinhoodchain.blockscout.com`
- $RWI token: `0xDa2598c976E62E7E15DcCa75169B404712E48B04`
- Fixed supply: 1,000,000,000 $RWI; no mint function
- Active $RWI/$WETH pool ID:
  `0xa72a9de2c6e3db34308a8ae61e927ceffea630218ca1e712b70b61341c3e99a1`
- Burn address: `0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD`
- The Index treasury: `0xb2c088db84293a6e3dee0765596f1cfdc2b9334d`
- $INDEX reward token: `0x56910d4409f3a0c78c64dd8d0545ff0705389870`
- $PONS reward token: `0x39dbed3a2bd333467115de45665cc57f813c4571`
- Donation vetting platform: [The Giving Block](https://thegivingblock.com/)

The public pages offer 13 language options (`en`, `es`, `zh`, `ja`, `ko`, `pt`,
`fr`, `ru`, `tr`, `vi`, `hi`, `de`, `id`) via `?lang=`. The JSON records use
English field names and recipient names. The token is a volatile digital
asset; nothing on this site is investment, tax, or legal advice.
